title: Harnessing CLIP and DINO: An Uncertainty-Aware Cascaded Fusion Network for Generalizable Deepfake Image Detection
abstract: arXiv:2609.07670v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The growing realism and accessibility of manipulated and generated faces threaten the trustworthiness of digital media. To detect such forgeries, deepfake detectors based on vision foundation models have shown promising performance, but they typically rely on a single pretrained representation and are prone to overfitting to particular training distributions. To improve generalization to unseen forgeries, we propose UCF-Net, an uncertainty-aware cascaded fusion network that harnesses CLIP's language-aligned semantic priors and DINO's self-supervised visual-structure priors. UCF-Net extracts hierarchical features across Transformer depths, uses layer-wise expert aggregation to adaptively combine each encoder's multi-level cues, and performs weighted fusion of the resulting representations based on entropy-derived uncertainty. translated_abstract: 经过篡改和生成的人脸图像日益逼真且易于获取，威胁着数字媒体的可信度。为了检测此类伪造内容，基于视觉基础模型的深度伪造检测器已展现出良好的性能，但它们通常依赖于单一的预训练表示，并且容易对特定训练分布产生过拟合。为了提升对未见伪造类型的泛化能力，我们提出了UCF-Net——一种不确定性感知级联融合网络，它充分利用CLIP的语言对齐语义先验和DINO的自监督视觉结构先验。UCF-Net在Transformer的各个深度上提取层次化特征，采用逐层专家聚合机制自适应地融合每个编码器的多层级线索，并基于熵导出的不确定性对所得表示进行加权融合。我们进一步将公开的深度伪造数据集整合为一个包含约400万张图像的统一基准，并构建
tldr: 提出UCF-Net，通过融合CLIP的语义先验与DINO的视觉结构先验，并利用熵不确定性进行加权级联融合，显著提升深度伪造图像检测对未见伪造类型的泛化能力。
en_tdlr: UCF-Net, an uncertainty-aware cascaded fusion network that combines CLIP's semantic priors and DINO's visual-structure priors with entropy-derived weighted fusion, achieves generalizable deepfake image detection on unseen forgeries.
